evidence.detail: ABBREVIATIONS dict contains rdw, ww, muc, mbc but NOT 'bug' (Sultai UBG shorthand) — the sanitizer does not recognize 'bug' as a color alias
WHITELIST has one entry 'Fix the Gargadon Bug Me Angy' to prevent the word 'bug' from being processed incorrectly — confirming the problem is real and only manually handled so far
normalize_colors has access to actual deck colors (the 'colors' param) but ABBREVIATIONS expansion happens before it and without color context, making context-aware 'bug'→Sultai non-trivial

triage.notes: A naïve fix (add 'bug': 'Sultai' to ABBREVIATIONS) would rename non-Sultai decks called 'Bug X' incorrectly. A correct fix needs color-context awareness — either moving the 'bug' alias into normalize_colors (which has the colors param) or adding it to COLOR_COMBINATIONS patterns with a guard on actual deck colors. Both approaches require tests in deck_name_test.py and careful consideration of edge cases.
